fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: EIP-8253 (nonce bump for non-zero storage accounts, replacement for DFI'd EIP-7610) not added to Glamsterdam; Hegota SFI request deferred

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8141 (Frame Transactions) formally confirmed as Hegota headliner; spec still being iterated
EIP-8411 (Fast Payload Broadcast): ACDE notified of upcoming PFI request; decision deferred to ACDC next week
EIP-8360 (TCREATE opcode): status still open; champion confirmed (Milos); decision deferred two weeks; will be included in next Forkcast ranking pass

hegota_scoping_dfi.highlight: DFI: EIP-7819 (set delegate instruction), EIP-7851 (code-controlled EOA delegation)
DFI: EIP-2488 (deprecate CALLCODE), EIP-8219 (checked arithmetic opcodes), EIP-8182 (private ETH/ERC-20 transfers), EIP-7645 (alias ORIGIN to sender)
DFI: EIP-8200 (EVMification of precompiles); revisit once precompile-replacement benchmarks mature
DFI: EIP-8188 (last written block for accounts/slots), EIP-8358 (net gas metering for account changes), EIP-8115 (batch priority fees at end of block)
DFI: EIP-7862 (delayed state root); may revisit post-Glamsterdam or alongside binary trie work
DFI: EIP-7807 (SSZ execution blocks); blast radius too high relative to near-term benefit
DFI: EIP-8094 (ETH/VHash blob-aware mempool); features already absorbed into sparse blob pool

hegota_scoping_delayed.highlight: EIP-7979 (call/return opcodes): decision delayed 2 weeks; Solidity/Vyper compiler teams should attend next call to weigh in
EIP-8163 (reserve EXTENSION opcode): delayed 2 weeks; champion must gather signals from L2/alt-L1 chains before next call
EIP-8372 (normalized state gas limit): not DFI'd today; to be resolved alongside EIP-8368 (CPSB recalibration), which has broad support and is a likely CFI
EIP-8304 (trustless log and transaction index): delayed 2 weeks; Besu/Reth open to further discussion; Zsolt to engage those teams
